assumptions: Git reports the relevant changed paths and existing validators remain authoritative for their owned domains; path classification is incomplete dependency metadata and therefore fails closed for unknown paths.
compatibility: No change to the Constitution, AIM, confluence certificates, assurance classes, analyzer CLI, report schemas, closure decisions or clean-room evidence contracts.
domain: Local Python 3.12 development and GitHub Actions validation of this repository's tracked and non-ignored untracked paths.
execution_contract: Read Git path state and run existing local validation commands; never capture or approve evidence, mutate Git history, publish, push, merge or run a clean-room protocol implicitly.
hypotheses: Proportional scheduling of unchanged validation gates will shorten feedback without increasing escaped defects; this operational expectation is not a scientific or safety claim.
observation_contract: Changed path inventory, selected domains and profiles, ordered command plans, exit codes, workflow structure and existing validator outputs.
